title: Scanned documents and bulk archive
summary: Scanned Word files and mixed PDFs now read in full, and you can archive conversations in bulk or reopen a closed matter.
body_markdown:
A couple of August updates worth knowing about.


## Documents that read properly


- Scanned Word documents now read properly instead of failing quietly.
- PDFs that combine typed and scanned pages get the scanned pages read too.


## A tidier workspace


- Archive several conversations at once with a single confirmation.
- Unarchive a matter you closed by mistake.
